scope: Recipe library, owned cover, ingredients, cooking and local handoff text scaling/scrolling plus four reproduced flat-background color roles.

preproduct_contract.font_policy: Measure actual static text native frames per same literal/role. Combined control envelopes recorded but not substituted for text-font growth; qualify rendered label masks separately if needed. Multi-line text height includes wrapping.
preproduct_contract.positive_control: Existing semantic answer readout settings title test, same OS preference categories
preproduct_contract.large_text_policy: Scrollable large text/controls need not all fit simultaneously; record actual clip/intersection and manually inspect start/end poses before any full-readability claim.
preproduct_contract.normal_pixel_contract: Corresponding normal viewport captures exact unless a separately reproduced color repair is explicitly included; no registration to conceal a different scroll pose.
actions: open/close only local handoff; never Offer

discovered_color_roles_before_product.method: Same fixed100th-darkest actual foreground pixel lower bound,100pixel minimum,2pt expandedROI+2pt ring/99%uniform,1pt known neighbor text exclusion as priorqualifiedrootcontrast. Use actual visible post-font scene for captions, not offscreen AX-only color ROI.
discovered_color_roles_before_product.normal_pixel_contract_extension: Only these4 separately reproduced flat-root color roles may intentionally change normal pixels; exact comparison outside declared2pt text/Label ROIs. Existing criterion allowed separately evidenced color repairs.

preproduct_contract.current_capture_additions: After baseline2 terminal and BEFORE product edit: observe visible row/timer/handoff/Next/policy, margin10forcaptureonly; record actual scroll clip, not only root viewport. Original functional center probes/values/callback assertions unchanged. Qualified before and current therefore have distinct UITest source pins; do not claim identical tests.

review_receipt.interrupted_view_output: One earlier completed four-contact tool result was context-truncated. Those four originals are not marked actually viewed. New three adaptive contacts instead cover the affected viewport poses.
observations: Normal artwork and geometry retained apart from declared text colors.
Largest text wraps and scrolls; several paragraphs and ingredient rows exceed the clip, with expected top/bottom clipping at observed scroll positions.
Cook title scrolls; timer/handoff/Next are visibly reachable at different positions.
Rounded-surface masks include text holes and exclude black exterior; original unqualified crops retained.
No all-at-once text visibility or real assistive acceptance inferred.

limits: Native AX text extent heights include wrapping;23 measured text roles per device are not24 ScaledMetric properties or44pt control-envelope growth.
Four initial helper failures used an unrelated instruction-scroll clip for a fixed footer. All four original results retained; corrected ancestor query qualified before product changes.
Current captures add five observation poses and actual scroll-clip metadata; original assertion lines retained but before/current test-source pins differ.
Named capture fields intersects_clip/visible_intersection use viewport intersection, not the effective scroll clip; effective_clip and fully_in_clip plus screenshot evidence are authoritative.
Long paragraphs/rows may exceed the scroll clip and are not all simultaneously visible. Center activation probes are not minimum-hit-size/edge or physical VoiceOver certification.

Original three post-color ROIs included black rounded-canvas exterior and remain unqualified; separately source-bound filled connected white-surface masks retain glyph holes, applied identically before/after. Not glass/photo contrast certification.
100th-darkest actual foreground core lower bound,minimum100pixels,4.5threshold;not every antialiased edge or physical photometric measurement.
